comment: The panel misspells the octave knob as Ocrtave; configParam calls it Octave. The panel letters the three waves A, B and C while configParam numbers them 1, 2 and 3, and the two middle-wave controls are lettered B-Wave and B-Width. Each oscillator's saw(), pulse() or triangle() advances the phase as a side effect (src/oscillator.hpp:32 to 38) and process() calls it twice per sample for each oscillator, once into the mix and once into that wave's own output (src/supersaw.cpp:262 and 263), so the phase advances two steps per sample and the wave outputs are one step ahead of what the mix uses. FREQ_C3 is 130.81 (src/oscillator.hpp:3), so the doubled advance puts 0V at the pitch input at about 261.6Hz. In the branch taken when the gate jack is unpatched, src/supersaw.cpp:292 applies the final level CV a second time to a value that already carries it (src/supersaw.cpp:248). Noise duration is 0 to 0.001 seconds and noise mix is 0 to 0.5. Eleven CV jacks carry the maker's second line 'Expects a 0-10V signal' and nothing more.
